properties.source: SCAR Antarctic Digital Database (ADD) coastline v7.10, British Antarctic Survey / SCAR (https://doi.org/10.5285/4ecd795d-e038-412f-b430-251b33fc880e), 'land' surface only.
properties.coordinate_order: [longitude, latitude], WGS84 / EPSG:4326 (reprojected from native EPSG:3031)
properties.note: Simplified for file size using a geometry-based (not centroid-based) split: any polygon area within 150 km of Bharati/Maitri keeps ~20 m tolerance, the rest uses 2500 m. Station coordinates NOT altered.
